notes.text: On Lazy's Discord (https://discord.com/invite/lazyicarus) under 'Channels & Roles' you can subscribe to roles for update pings: 'Kerberos's Projects' (Alarielle, Azazel's Realm, ...) and 'Soil's projects' (Soil's Corrupted Units). Bugs for Lazy submods (e.g. the Soboro Miao reskin) are reported there; there are support channels per submod.
Kerberos 2 additionally runs their own Discord: https://discord.gg/W4qkrNwUMk (link on the Alarielle page).

Many lewd mods (Alarielle, Azazel's Realm, Kerberos Mod Assets, Readman submods, Lazy's Morathi) are 'unlisted' on Steam and reachable only via links on the LL page. Where nudity mods are region-blocked, Windows+R -> 'steam://openurl/<workshop-link>' helps.

notes.topic: Debugging: PJ Console and Context Viewer
notes.text: For Lazy Framework / Kerberos mods the author requires Console Commands (PJ Console, Steam 2791241084) with 'Enable context viewer' enabled. Script errors appear in red at the top left; search script_log_###.txt in the WH3 folder for 'BIG FAT SCRIPT ERROR'. Kerberos_mod_log.txt shows in turn 1 whether the Alarielle/Azazel mod has started. Without these screenshots there is no support.

notes.topic: Framework families: Lazy vs. Generic Framework
notes.text: Two separate framework families: (1) Lazy's Corruption Framework (Steam 3464018577 or bundle 3472332568; basis for the Miao/Katarin/Morathi progression, Alarielle, Azazel's Realm). (2) Generic Framework (通用框架, Steam 3376886102) by 混沌破龍斩 for Corrupted Ascension, Corrupted Drycha, Summon Servant. According to the Alarielle page, Corrupted Ascension is incompatible with anything on Lazy's Framework (Habu-style 'tdw_*' and Kerberos mods).

Habu's tdw_corrupted_buildings* mods are meant for Miao. Disable them when playing as Alarielle (script errors, no benefit); use Kerberos' Steam version 'Corrupted Wood Elf Units for Slaanesh' (3566849815) instead. The Korean variant of the list partly contradicts this.

Recommended: @n_SlaaneshVictories.pack and @n_SlaaneshVassals_Non_Slaanesh_Factions.pack (script support in the mod). Do NOT use n_SlaaneshVictories_Confederations. Slaanesh Victories events only kick in from Alarielle corruption level 5+.

Useful from corruption level 5: Slaanesh UI theme (3304325611), Readman Late Lavish Looks (3528693285), flags (ll-41124 or Readman HD 3536009143). The Slaanesh UI theme needs Unique Faction UI (2789999718).

Soil's Corrupted Units (ll-32374) needs the asset pack + a faction-specific mod. ll-48415 is a community replacement for the asset pack (fixes overwriting of vanilla Cathay units). The Azazel version must sit above Azazel's Realm.
Dwjliel (Sexy Cathay Heroes Collection etc.): 'Load order should be automatic, but sub-mods obviously go above their parents.' Submods sit above the Steam parent mods.

notes.topic: Endo mods: Nexus instead of LL
notes.text: Endo's mods were re-uploaded on LL by third parties (e.g. ll-33604). The original author uploaded to Nexus Mods again in 2024-10 (mod 228); the uploader recommends downloading from there.

According to Kerberos, SFO causes CTDs in Miao/Azazel quest battles and unbalanced new heroes. For SFO players there are separate mini patches (ll-29487 'No corruption reduction for Dragon Wrath') and the SFO compatibility patch 3691683876 for ATB.
